messages.subject: Re: Error in library(NicheMapR) : there is no package called ‘NicheMapR’
messages.subject_clean: Error in library(NicheMapR) : there is no package called ‘NicheMapR’
messages.body_plain:
Hi Molly - R is case sensitive. You need: install_github("mrke/NicheMapR").

This version may not work right now - I'm in the middle of changing a couple of things.

If you install the latest release from https://github.com/mrke/NicheMapR/releases it will work.

All the best,
Mike

messages.subject: Re: Error in library(NicheMapR) : there is no package called ‘NicheMapR’
messages.subject_clean: Error in library(NicheMapR) : there is no package called ‘NicheMapR’
messages.body_plain:
Hi Mike,

I fixed it, it worked when I downloaded and installed NicheMapR 1.1.3 and not NicheMapR 1.1.4....
included reference code below for others who need help troubleshooting

#Rstudio
> install.packages("~/R/win-library/3.4/NicheMapR-1.1.4.zip", repos = NULL, type = "win.binary")
Installing package into ‘~/Documents/R/win-library/3.4’
(as ‘lib’ is unspecified)
> library(`NicheMapR-1.1.4`)
Error in library(`NicheMapR-1.1.4`) :
  there is no package called ‘NicheMapR-1.1.4’
> install.packages("~/Downloads/NicheMapR_1.1.3.zip", repos = NULL, type = "win.binary")
Installing package into ‘~/Documents/R/win-library/3.4’
(as ‘lib’ is unspecified)
package ‘NicheMapR’ successfully unpacked and MD5 sums checked
> library(NicheMapR)
#package NicheMapR shows up as an available package now that it's successfully unpacked.
>
